name: banzai-api-kb
description: banzai-api-kb (ADR-038, R6): the Rust retrieval engine for the live banzai-api. Faithful port of knowledge.js normalize/scoreEntry/retrieveTopK over the embedded entry keyword index. Deterministic; no LLM, no network. Compiles native (parity tests) and to Node WASM (the live service loads it).
